items.docs: Authenticate a user with a specified [authentication method](/reference/authkit/authentication).

params.name: code_challenge_method
params.description: The only valid PKCE code challenge method is `"S256"`. Required when specifying a `code_challenge`.

params.name: code_challenge
params.description: Code challenge derived from the code verifier used for the PKCE flow.

params.name: domain_hint
params.description: A domain hint for SSO connection lookup.

params.name: connection_id
params.description: The ID of an SSO connection to use for authentication.

params.name: provider_query_params
params.description: Key/value pairs of query parameters to pass to the OAuth provider.

params.name: provider_scopes
params.description: Additional OAuth scopes to request from the identity provider.

params.name: invitation_token
params.description: A token representing a user invitation to redeem during authentication.

params.name: screen_hint
params.description: Used to specify which screen to display when the provider is `authkit`.

params.name: login_hint
params.description: A hint to the authorization server about the login identifier the user might use.

params.name: provider
params.description: The OAuth provider to authenticate with (e.g., GoogleOAuth, MicrosoftOAuth, GitHubOAuth).

params.name: prompt
params.description: Controls the authentication flow behavior for the user.

params.name: state
params.description: An opaque value used to maintain state between the request and the callback.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: The ID of the organization to authenticate the user against.

params.name: response_type
params.description: The response type of the application.

params.name: redirect_uri
params.description: The callback URI where the authorization code will be sent after authentication.

params.name: client_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the WorkOS environment client.

items.docs: Generates an OAuth 2.0 authorization URL to authenticate a user with AuthKit or SSO.

Initiates the CLI Auth flow by requesting a device code and verification URLs. This endpoint implements the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Flow ([RFC 8628](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8628)) and is designed for command-line applications or other devices with limited input capabilities.

params.name: session_id
params.description: The ID of the session to revoke. This can be extracted from the `sid` claim of the access token.

params.name: return_to
params.description: The URL to redirect the user to after session revocation.

items.docs: Logout a user from the current [session](/reference/authkit/session).
